claims.claim: The US Treasury raised $839 billion through 11 auctions in the most recent week, a new record.
claims.episode_span: The latest week saw $839 billion in gross auctions across 11 sales of bills, floating-rate notes and notes due in two, five and seven years, eclipsing the prior record of $834 billion set a year earlier.
claims.source_title: US Treasury Runs Record $839 Billion Auction Week
claims.supporting_quote: Per Bloomberg, the Treasury raised $839 billion this week through its sales of Treasury bills and notes, a new all-time record for gross issuance in one week.

claims.claim: Only $106 billion of the $839 billion represented net new cash raised by the government.
claims.episode_span: Only $106 billion represented net new cash after the balance rolled over maturing debt, far below the pandemic-era weekly peak of nearly $362 billion seen in March and April 2020.
claims.source_title: US Treasury Runs Record $839 Billion Auction Week
claims.supporting_quote: That net figure is far below the pandemic-era peak. In March and April 2020, weekly net cash raised by the Treasury hit nearly $362 billion as auction sizes surged to fund the emergency response.

claims.claim: Hydro One reported revenue of $2.3 billion in the second quarter, up 11 percent year-over-year, with net profit up 13 percent to $370 million.
claims.episode_span: Revenue rose 11 percent year-over-year to $2.3 billion in the latest quarter, supported by approved rate increases and peak demand growth, while net profit climbed 13 percent year-over-year to $370 million.
claims.source_title: How to Diversify Your Portfolio Beyond Canadian Banks
claims.supporting_quote: In the second quarter to $2.3 billion. This drove its net profit up by 13% YoY to $370 million.

claims.claim: Hydro One has filed applications for the $1.9 billion Northeast Power Line and the $1.2 billion Longwood to Lakeshore Transmission Line.
claims.episode_span: Hydro One continues to invest heavily in Ontario’s electricity network, including applications for the roughly $1.9 billion Northeast Power Line and the $1.2 billion Longwood to Lakeshore Transmission Line.
claims.source_title: How to Diversify Your Portfolio Beyond Canadian Banks
claims.supporting_quote: The company has filed applications for several major transmission projects, including the roughly $1.9 billion Northeast Power Line and the $1.2 billion Longwood to Lakeshore Transmission Line.

claims.claim: OPay raised $304 million in a US IPO before halting its NYSE listing due to a regulatory inquiry.
claims.episode_span: Nigeria-focused payments platform OPay paused its planned NYSE listing after raising $304 million, citing an ongoing regulatory review that delayed the expected Friday debut.
claims.source_title: OPay Halts IPO To Respond To Regulatory Inquiry
claims.supporting_quote: OPay has halted its initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange amid a regulatory inquiry. Shares of the SoftBank-backed fintech didn't begin trading as expected on Friday after the company raised 304-million dollars in a US IPO.

claims.claim: Marqeta is expected to report 7.4 percent year-over-year revenue growth for Q3.
claims.episode_span: For Marqeta, the preview shows expected 7.4 percent revenue growth this quarter against a history of beating estimates, with peers Asure Software and Paychex already reported.
claims.source_title: Marqeta (MQ) Q3 earnings report preview: what to look for
claims.supporting_quote: This quarter, the market is expecting Marqeta's revenue to grow 7.4% year on year, slowing from the 27.6% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.
